capabilities: Create Todoist tasks via a quick-add modal or from selected text or the current line
Deep-link created tasks back to the current Obsidian note
Search Todoist for matching tasks and delete confirmed matches
View and interact with tasks in a dedicated Todoist sidebar
Render task lists in notes from Todoist filter queries
extras: Requires building the plugin from source with Node.js 24+ and pnpm. OAuth setup depends on GitHub Pages serving a callback page. Makes background requests to api.todoist.com and discloses WASM and fs module bundle inclusions.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to create, search, or display Todoist tasks without leaving the app.

relations.evidence: A robust integration between Todoist and Obsidian for managing your tasks natively within your knowledge base.

summary: Todoist integration that adds tasks from Obsidian, checks for existing tasks, shows a sidebar, and renders tasks from filter queries.
